html:
Silver Touch Hospitals is a reputed network of hospitals handling emergencies with skill and expertise. We understand how fast an ordinary day can convert into a crisis. Our patients experience everything from sharp chest pains to children with difficulty breathing, and the question in their minds is always the same: Should I wait or go to the hospital immediately?

Being a chain of hospitals dealing with multi-specialities throughout the city, we are well prepared to react swiftly and efficiently when crises occur. Let us tell you of a few situations where immediately heading to an emergency care hospital in Ahmedabad like ours is necessary.

  • Chest Pain or Tightness

Chest discomfort that comes on suddenly and feels like pressure, heaviness, or squeezing should never be ignored. If the pain moves to your arm, jaw, or back and is accompanied by sweating or shortness of breath, it could be a heart attack. Call an ambulance or get to the nearest emergency department immediately. Don’t take a chance.

  • Difficulty Breathing

Difficulty breathing or gasping can be a symptom of a serious condition, if wheezing, chest pain, or bluish lips or fingertips are present. Whatever it is – a lung problem, allergic reaction, or asthma attack – it’s time to have emergency medical care immediately.

  • Loss of Consciousness or Sudden Confusion

If a person faints unexpectedly, is confused, or seizes, these are indicative of a stroke, brain trauma, or neurological issue. When dealing with strokes, minutes matter. The sooner we can respond, the greater the likelihood of recovery.

  • Serious Injuries or Accidents

Deep cuts, falls, broken bones, burns, or head injuries must have immediate care. Our trauma experts are equipped to evaluate, stabilise, and treat intricate injuries with no delay.

  • Excessive Bleeding or Sustained High Fever

Oozing that does not stop with pressure, a high fever greater than 103°F, or high-temperature-induced seizures, particularly in children, should never be ignored. Seek help right away.

Trust Silver Touch Hospitals – A Network That’s Built for Emergencies

Being an emergency care hospital in Ahmedabad, Silver Touch Hospitals provides round-the-clock critical care accompanied by in-house diagnostics, ICU care, and 24/7 specialists. Our emergency teams of all ages, from infants to older adults, cater to their respective medical conditions with care and promptness.

In any crisis, listen to your instincts. If you suspect something is terribly wrong, it likely is. Let us at Silver Touch Hospitals take it from here. We’re here, standing by, and equipped to save lives.
